title: DACS Intro Camp 2026
subtitle: Participant Agreement, Camp Rules, Payment and Refund Policy

blocks.text: 1. Purpose and acceptance of this agreement
This Participant Agreement, Camp Rules, Payment and Refund Policy applies to every person registering for or attending DACS Intro Camp 2026, organised by Study Association MSV Incognito.
By purchasing or using a ticket, completing the registration process and accepting this agreement, the participant confirms that they:

items: Have read and understood this agreement;
Understand that the event takes place in Belgium;
Agree to comply with applicable Belgian laws and regulations;
Agree to follow the reasonable instructions of MSV Incognito’s coordinators;
Understand that they remain responsible for their own conduct, decisions and personal safety;
Understand the cancellation, replacement and refund rules.

blocks.text: A person who does not agree with these terms must not complete the registration or attend the event.
Where a provision of this agreement conflicts with mandatory applicable law, mandatory law takes precedence.
2. Event information
DACS Intro Camp 2026 is a weekend-long trip organised by Study Association MSV Incognito for incoming Bachelor’s and Master’s students.
The event takes place at:
Bivak Zandhoek
3680 Opoeteren, Belgium
The intended event period is:
Friday 11 September 2026 at 18:00 until Sunday 13 September 2026 at 16:00.
The ticket is intended to include:

items: Transport to and from the venue using transport arranged by MSV Incognito;
Alcoholic drinks where provided and legally permitted;

blocks.text: The final meeting point, departure time, return time, packing list, room allocation and programme may be communicated separately before the event.
Participants must follow the final schedule communicated by MSV Incognito.

MSV Incognito may make reasonable changes to the programme, schedule, activities, food arrangements, transport or accommodation where necessary because of safety requirements, weather, venue requirements, transport disruption, supplier availability or other organisational circumstances.
3. Eligibility and age
Intro Camp 2026 is primarily intended for incoming Bachelor’s and Master’s students.
Participants are expected to be adults and to behave responsibly.
A person under 18 may participate only where MSV Incognito has expressly approved their participation in writing and all required parental or guardian permissions have been completed.
MSV Incognito may request valid proof of identity and age.
Alcohol will not be provided to a person where doing so would be prohibited by applicable law.

Providing false or misleading information concerning identity, age, student status, health, eligibility or any other important registration information may result in refusal of participation or removal from the event.
4. Registration and personal ticket
Each participant must possess a valid personal ticket or booking confirmation issued through MSV Incognito’s Pretix ticketing system for DACS Intro Camp 2026.
A participant may be required to present their ticket:

items: When requested by an MSV Incognito coordinator;
When requested by the venue or a relevant service provider.

blocks.text: The name on the ticket must correspond with the identity of the participant unless a replacement or ticket transfer has been approved by MSV Incognito.
Tickets may not be copied, duplicated, resold, transferred or provided to another person without prior approval from MSV Incognito.
Possession of a ticket does not guarantee participation where the participant fails to satisfy the identification, eligibility, conduct or safety requirements in this agreement.
5. Payment
5.1 Payment through Pretix
Tickets are normally purchased and paid for through MSV Incognito’s Pretix ticketing page.
Participants must use one of the payment methods made available during the Pretix checkout process.
A registration is confirmed only when:

items: The required registration information has been provided;
The participant has accepted the required terms;
The full ticket price has been paid or otherwise confirmed by MSV Incognito; and
Pretix or MSV Incognito has issued a valid ticket or booking confirmation.

blocks.text: A registration that remains unpaid after the applicable payment deadline may be cancelled.
5.2 Payment by bank transfer upon request
A participant who cannot or does not wish to pay through the payment options available in Pretix may request permission to pay by direct bank transfer.
The request must be sent to:
incognito@maastrichtuniversity.nl
Bank-transfer payment is available only after MSV Incognito has approved the request and provided official payment instructions.
The participant must not transfer money to an MSV Incognito bank account without first receiving the correct payment details, payment reference and deadline.
A bank-transfer registration is not confirmed until the full payment has been received and matched to the participant’s registration.
The participant is responsible for:

items: Ensuring that the payment arrives before the stated deadline.

blocks.text: MSV Incognito is not responsible for delays caused by incorrect payment information, missing references, bank processing times or payments sent to the wrong account.
6. Identification and travel documents
Every participant must carry a valid passport or officially recognised national identity card throughout the journey and event.
Each participant is personally responsible for possessing:

items: A passport or national identity card valid for travel to Belgium;
Any visa required for their circumstances;
Any residence permit or immigration document required for their circumstances;
Any other travel document that may be required;
Their personal Intro Camp 2026 ticket or booking confirmation;

blocks.text: A student card, driver’s licence, photograph of an identity document or expired identity document may not be accepted as a valid international travel document.
Participants must present their identification when reasonably requested by:
Each participant is responsible for determining which documents are required based on their nationality, residence status and personal circumstances.
A participant who cannot travel to Belgium or attend the event because they do not possess the required documents remains subject to the cancellation and refund policy in this agreement.
MSV Incognito is not responsible for a participant being refused transport, entry into Belgium or participation because of missing, invalid, expired or incorrect documents.
7. Cross-border event and compliance with Belgian law
MSV Incognito is an association established in the Netherlands. Intro Camp 2026 takes place in Belgium.
Throughout the event, including during transport, accommodation, organised activities and personal free time, participants must comply with:

items: Applicable Belgian regional laws and regulations;
Instructions issued by competent Belgian authorities;
Rules imposed by transport companies and activity providers;
The MSV Incognito Code of Conduct;
This Participant Agreement and Camp Rules;
Reasonable and lawful instructions issued by MSV Incognito coordinators.

blocks.text: Each participant is personally responsible for their own unlawful conduct.

A participant remains personally responsible for any fine, penalty, investigation, arrest, prosecution, loss, expense or other legal consequence resulting from their failure to comply with applicable law.
MSV Incognito is not responsible for protecting a participant from the legal consequences of that participant’s own actions.
Conduct that may constitute a criminal offence may be reported to the Belgian police, emergency services, venue management, Maastricht University or another competent organisation.
8. Instructions from MSV Incognito coordinators
Participants must listen to and follow the reasonable and lawful instructions of MSV Incognito’s designated coordinators.
Coordinator instructions may concern:
Participants must arrive at agreed meeting locations on time.
Participants must remain with the group where instructed to do so.
A participant who does not understand an instruction must immediately ask a coordinator for clarification.
A participant who disagrees with an instruction should discuss the issue with a coordinator, provided that doing so does not delay an urgent safety response.
Serious or repeated refusal to follow reasonable instructions may result in exclusion from an activity or removal from the event.
9. Personal responsibility
Each participant is responsible for their own:
Participants must behave responsibly and exercise reasonable care to avoid causing injury, death, loss or damage to themselves or another person.
Participants are responsible for assessing whether they are physically and mentally capable of participating safely in an activity.
A participant must not participate in an activity where they are:

items: Under the influence of illegal substances;

blocks.text: A participant must stop participating and contact a coordinator where they feel unsafe or unable to continue.

A participant remains personally responsible, in accordance with applicable law, for injury, death, loss or damage resulting from their own intentional, reckless, negligent, dangerous or unlawful conduct.
Intoxication, peer pressure, excitement, poor judgement or failure to read these rules does not excuse harmful, dangerous or unlawful behaviour.
10. Acknowledgement of ordinary event risks
Participants understand that Intro Camp 2026 may involve ordinary risks associated with:
Participants voluntarily decide whether to participate in individual activities.
A participant who does not wish to participate in an activity should inform a coordinator.
A participant must not pressure another participant to join an activity, consume alcohol or engage in conduct that the other person does not want.
11. Injury or harm caused to another person
Participants must not intentionally, recklessly or negligently injure, endanger, threaten or otherwise cause harm to:
A participant who causes injury, death, loss or damage to another person remains personally responsible for their conduct in accordance with applicable civil and criminal law.
A participant may be required to reimburse direct, reasonable and documented costs arising from their conduct to the extent permitted by applicable law.
MSV Incognito does not automatically become responsible for harm caused by one participant to another person merely because the incident occurred during Intro Camp 2026.
This does not exclude any responsibility that MSV Incognito may have under mandatory applicable law.
Violence, threats, physical assault, harassment, sexual misconduct or other dangerous behaviour may result in immediate removal from the event and reporting to the competent authorities.
12. Respectful behaviour and consent
MSV Incognito aims to provide a safe, welcoming and inclusive environment.
Participants must treat other people with dignity and respect.
The following behaviour is prohibited:

items: Sexual activity without clear and freely given consent;
Offensive conduct targeting another person’s characteristics;
Creating a deliberately unsafe or hostile environment;
Retaliating against a person who reports a concern.

blocks.text: Consent must be freely given, informed and specific.
Consent may be withdrawn at any time.
A person who is asleep, unconscious or severely intoxicated cannot provide valid consent.
Participants should report inappropriate behaviour to a coordinator immediately.

Reports will be handled as discreetly as reasonably possible. Complete confidentiality cannot be guaranteed where action is required to protect someone, investigate serious misconduct or comply with the law.
13. Alcohol, illegal drugs and dangerous items
Participants who consume alcohol do so voluntarily and remain responsible for their decisions and conduct.
No participant will be required or pressured to consume alcohol.
Participants must:

items: Follow venue rules relating to alcohol;
Stop consuming alcohol when instructed by a coordinator or venue employee;
Avoid behaviour that threatens their safety or another person’s safety;
Not drive or operate a vehicle while impaired;
Not provide alcohol to another person where doing so is unlawful;
Not use intoxication as an excuse for misconduct.

blocks.text: MSV Incognito may:

items: Stop serving alcohol to a participant;
Prevent an intoxicated participant from joining an activity;
Contact an emergency contact or medical professional where necessary;
Take other reasonable measures to protect the participant or other people.

blocks.text: The possession, use, production, supply or distribution of illegal drugs is prohibited.
Weapons, explosives, fireworks and other dangerous or unlawful items are prohibited unless expressly authorised for a legitimate supervised activity.
Smoking and vaping are permitted only in areas where they are allowed under Belgian law and venue rules.
14. Health, medication and dietary requirements
Participants are responsible for assessing whether they are medically and physically able to attend the event.
Participants must provide accurate information about relevant:

items: Other circumstances that may be important during an emergency.

blocks.text: Relevant information should be provided during registration or communicated to MSV Incognito as soon as reasonably possible.
Participants are responsible for bringing sufficient necessary medication and for using and storing it correctly.
MSV Incognito coordinators are not medical professionals unless expressly identified otherwise.
Coordinators cannot provide medical diagnoses, guarantee medical supervision or replace professional medical care.

MSV Incognito will take reasonable steps to communicate declared dietary requirements to relevant providers. However, MSV Incognito cannot guarantee a completely allergen-free environment or the complete absence of cross-contamination.
A participant with a serious allergy or significant medical condition should personally inform a coordinator at the beginning of the event.
15. Emergencies
In an urgent or potentially life-threatening situation, participants must immediately:

items: Follow instructions from emergency personnel and coordinators;
Provide accurate information about the situation.

blocks.text: Participants must not delay contacting emergency services while waiting for permission from MSV Incognito.
Where reasonably necessary, MSV Incognito may:

items: Provide basic first assistance within the competence of the available person;
Share necessary information with medical professionals;
Arrange transport to a medical facility;
Contact the venue or relevant authorities;
Take reasonable steps to protect participants and other persons.

blocks.text: Medical assessment and treatment decisions remain the responsibility of the participant and qualified medical professionals.

Participants are responsible for their own medical, hospital, transport, repatriation and related personal expenses unless those expenses are covered by insurance or are legally payable by another responsible party.
16. Reporting problems and requesting assistance
Participants should contact an MSV Incognito coordinator immediately and without hesitation concerning any problem, question or concern.
This includes:
Reporting a problem does not automatically mean that the reporting participant will be punished.
Coordinators will assess the situation based on:

items: The rights of the persons involved;

blocks.text: Participants must provide truthful information and cooperate reasonably with coordinators, venue staff, emergency services and competent authorities.
A participant who knowingly submits a false or malicious report may be subject to disciplinary action.
17. Damage to property
Participants must use the venue, accommodation, vehicles, furniture, equipment and other property carefully and only for their intended purpose.
Participants must not intentionally, recklessly or negligently damage, destroy, deface, lose or misuse property belonging to:
A participant who causes property damage may be required to pay the direct, reasonable and documented repair or replacement costs to the extent that the participant is legally responsible.
Normal wear and tear is excluded.
Where several participants jointly cause damage, responsibility may be assessed according to each person’s involvement and applicable law.
Participants must report accidental damage immediately.
Prompt and honest reporting will be taken into account when MSV Incognito assesses the incident.
Deliberately concealing property damage may be treated as a separate rule violation.
MSV Incognito may provide relevant information concerning property damage to the venue, property owner, insurer or competent authorities where legally permitted.
18. Theft and failure to return property
Participants may not take, retain, conceal, move or use property belonging to another person or organisation without permission.
Borrowed items, keys, access cards, equipment and other materials must be returned:

items: No later than the end of the event.

blocks.text: A participant who fails to return an item may be required to pay its reasonable and documented replacement cost.
Suspected theft or deliberate retention of property may result in:

items: Investigation by MSV Incognito or the venue;
Notification of Maastricht University where appropriate;

blocks.text: MSV Incognito will not publicly identify a participant as responsible for theft without an appropriate basis for doing so.
19. Personal belongings
Participants remain responsible for supervising their own:
Participants should not leave valuable or important items unattended.
MSV Incognito is not responsible for personal belongings that are unattended, forgotten, misplaced, damaged or stolen, except where responsibility cannot lawfully be excluded.
Lost property should be reported to a coordinator.
MSV Incognito may temporarily store recovered items but does not guarantee that lost items will be found or returned.
Unclaimed property may be disposed of or donated after a reasonable retention period.
20. Accommodation, venue and fire-safety rules
Participants must comply with all accommodation and venue rules, including rules relating to:
Participants may not:

items: Disable, cover, remove or tamper with smoke detectors or fire alarms;
Activate a fire alarm, alarm button or manual call point without a genuine or reasonably believed fire or emergency;
Move, remove, obstruct, discharge, damage or misuse a fire extinguisher;
Block, lock or obstruct an emergency exit, escape route, fire door or access to fire-safety equipment;
Interfere with emergency lighting, evacuation signs, fire blankets, sprinkler systems or any other safety equipment;
Enter another person’s sleeping area without permission;
Deliberately damage or excessively dirty the accommodation.

blocks.text: 20.1 Fire alarms, fire extinguishers and emergency equipment

Fire alarms, smoke detectors, alarm buttons, manual call points, fire extinguishers, fire blankets, emergency lighting, fire doors, evacuation signs and other fire-safety equipment are provided only for safety and emergency purposes.
Participants must comply with applicable Belgian law, venue rules and instructions from coordinators, venue staff and emergency personnel concerning fire safety.
A participant may activate a fire alarm or manual call point only where:

items: There is an actual fire or emergency;
The participant reasonably and honestly believes that there is a fire or emergency; or
The participant has been instructed to do so by a coordinator, venue employee or emergency professional.

blocks.text: A participant may use a fire extinguisher or fire blanket only:

items: In an actual or reasonably believed fire emergency;
Where using it is reasonably necessary, appropriate and safe;
In accordance with the equipment instructions and applicable law; or
When instructed by a coordinator, venue employee or emergency professional.

blocks.text: Participants must not place themselves or others in unnecessary danger by attempting to fight a fire. Raising the alarm, warning others, evacuating through the designated escape routes and contacting emergency services take priority.
When a fire alarm sounds or an evacuation instruction is given, participants must:

items: Leave the building promptly using the designated escape route;
Not use an elevator where prohibited;
Proceed to the designated assembly point;
Follow instructions from coordinators, venue staff and emergency personnel;
Not re-enter the building until authorised to do so.

blocks.text: Any defect, damage, accidental activation or suspected misuse involving fire-safety equipment must be reported immediately to a coordinator or venue employee.

Intentional, reckless or unauthorised activation, discharge, removal, obstruction, damage or misuse of fire-safety equipment is a serious violation of this agreement. Subject to applicable law and the circumstances, it may result in one or more measures under this agreement, including:

items: Immediate removal from the event without a refund;
Reimbursement of direct, reasonable and documented call-out, cleaning, repair, replacement or other costs;
Notification of the venue, Maastricht University or an insurer;
Reporting to Belgian emergency services, police or another competent authority.

blocks.text: A participant remains personally responsible, in accordance with applicable law, for injury, loss, damage, costs, fines or other consequences caused by their misuse of fire-safety equipment.

No participant will be sanctioned under this agreement solely for activating an alarm or using fire-safety equipment honestly and in good faith in response to an actual or reasonably perceived emergency.
MSV Incognito coordinators or venue staff may enter accommodation areas where reasonably necessary because of:
Participants must leave sleeping and shared areas in a reasonably clean condition.
21. Transport rules
Participants using transport arranged by MSV Incognito must:

items: Arrive at the meeting point on time;
Follow instructions from coordinators and drivers;
Keep aisles and emergency exits clear;
Avoid damaging or excessively dirtying the vehicle;
Comply with the transport provider’s rules;
Not bring prohibited or dangerous items.

blocks.text: A participant who misses arranged transport because of their own lateness is responsible for arranging and paying for alternative transport.
MSV Incognito is not required to delay the group for a participant who is late or absent.
Where transport is disrupted, MSV Incognito will take reasonable steps to communicate the situation and arrange an appropriate solution. MSV Incognito cannot guarantee that delays will not occur.
22. Removal from the event
MSV Incognito may issue a warning, restrict participation in an activity or remove a participant from the event where reasonably necessary because of:

items: A serious or repeated violation of this agreement;
Refusal to follow reasonable safety instructions;
Intentional, reckless or unauthorised activation, obstruction, damage or misuse of a fire alarm, fire extinguisher or other fire-safety equipment;
Illegal drug possession, use or distribution;
Possession of a weapon or dangerous item;

blocks.text: Immediate removal may occur where necessary to protect participants, coordinators, venue staff or other persons.
Where reasonably possible, the participant will be informed of the reason for the decision and given an opportunity to explain their position.
A participant removed because of their own serious misconduct is not entitled to a refund, except where mandatory law requires otherwise.
The removed participant may be responsible for arranging and paying for their own return journey.
Where necessary for safety, MSV Incognito may assist with arranging the journey. The participant remains responsible for the associated cost unless applicable law provides otherwise.
Serious incidents may also be reported to:
23. Participant cancellation and refund policy
A participant who wishes to cancel must submit a clear cancellation request to:
incognito@maastrichtuniversity.nl
The cancellation request should include:

items: The Pretix order number or ticket number;
The email address used for the registration;
Any other information reasonably required to identify the registration.

blocks.text: 23.1 Cancellations submitted by 1 September 2026
A participant who submits a cancellation request no later than:
1 September 2026 at 23:59 Central European Summer Time
is eligible for a full refund of the ticket price.
23.2 Cancellations after 1 September 2026
Cancellation requests submitted after:
1 September 2026 at 23:59 CEST
are non-refundable, except where:

items: A refund is required by mandatory applicable law;
MSV Incognito cancels the entire event;
MSV Incognito expressly agrees otherwise in writing.

blocks.text: After the refund deadline, a participant who can no longer attend may find an eligible replacement participant and request a ticket transfer in accordance with Section 24.
Failure to find a replacement participant does not create a right to a refund.
The following circumstances do not automatically create a right to a refund after the deadline:

items: Travel disruption unrelated to transport arranged by MSV Incognito;
Failure to obtain a visa or residence document;
Removal because of the participant’s own misconduct;
Failure to find an eligible replacement participant.

blocks.text: Participants are encouraged to consider suitable cancellation or travel insurance.
24. Replacement participants and ticket transfers
A participant who can no longer attend Intro Camp 2026 may propose another person to attend in their place.
This option remains available after the refund deadline of 1 September 2026 at 23:59 CEST, subject to the conditions in this section.
A replacement is valid only after MSV Incognito has approved and completed the change.
The original participant must contact:
incognito@maastrichtuniversity.nl
The request must include:

items: The original Pretix order number or ticket number;
Any other information requested by MSV Incognito.

blocks.text: The replacement participant must:

items: Be eligible to attend Intro Camp 2026;
Accept this Participant Agreement, Camp Rules, Payment and Refund Policy;
Provide dietary, medical, accessibility and emergency-contact information where requested;
Possess valid identification and required travel documents;
Satisfy all applicable safety and participation requirements.

blocks.text: MSV Incognito may refuse a proposed replacement where:

items: The replacement participant does not satisfy the eligibility requirements;
The request is made too late for the participant list to be changed;
Final information has already been submitted to the venue, transport provider, insurer or another supplier;
The replacement creates a legal, safety, insurance or organisational problem;
There are reasonable grounds to believe the transfer is fraudulent or involves unauthorised ticket resale.

blocks.text: A transfer is not complete until MSV Incognito provides written confirmation and, where applicable, Pretix has issued an updated ticket.
Until written confirmation has been issued, the ticket remains registered to the original participant.
The proposed replacement may not attend using a ticket that remains registered to another person.
24.1 Payment arrangements for replacements
MSV Incognito may process an approved replacement in one of the following ways:

items: The original participant and replacement participant arrange payment privately between themselves; or
MSV Incognito creates or updates a Pretix registration for the replacement participant; or
MSV Incognito permits the replacement participant to pay by bank transfer after a written request and approval.

blocks.text: MSV Incognito will determine the appropriate administrative method for each replacement.
Where the original participant and replacement participant settle privately, MSV Incognito is not responsible for:
Where MSV Incognito requires the replacement participant to pay MSV Incognito directly, any refund to the original participant will be processed only after:

items: The replacement participant has completed the registration;
The replacement participant’s full payment has been received;
All information necessary to process the refund has been provided.

blocks.text: The original participant is not entitled to receive both a private payment from the replacement participant and a refund from MSV Incognito for the same ticket.
Tickets may not be sold to a replacement participant for more than the original ticket price without prior written approval from MSV Incognito.
MSV Incognito may communicate a final practical deadline for replacement requests where necessary to finalise transport, accommodation, food, insurance, emergency information or participant lists.
25. Processing eligible refunds
25.1 Pretix payments
Where technically possible, an eligible refund for a ticket purchased through Pretix will be processed through Pretix or the original payment method.
The availability of an automatic refund depends on the payment method and payment-processing system used for the original transaction.
25.2 Manual refunds for iDEAL payments
Eligible refunds for some iDEAL payments may need to be processed manually because the payment-processing system may not support an automatic refund.
Where a manual refund is necessary, the participant may be asked to provide:

items: The IBAN to which the refund should be sent;
Information needed to verify the original payment.

blocks.text: Manual processing does not affect whether the participant is eligible for a refund.
MSV Incognito will normally send a manual refund to the person or account associated with the original payment.
A refund to a different account may be refused or may require additional verification.
25.3 Refunds for bank-transfer payments
Where a participant paid by bank transfer with the approval of MSV Incognito, an eligible refund will normally be returned by bank transfer.
MSV Incognito may return the payment to the originating bank account unless another arrangement has been verified and approved.
25.4 Refund timing
Approved refunds will be processed as soon as reasonably practicable and normally within 14 days after:

items: The refund has been approved; and
MSV Incognito has received all information required to process it.

blocks.text: MSV Incognito does not charge an additional fee solely because a refund must be processed manually.
The participant is responsible for providing accurate banking information.
MSV Incognito is not responsible for a failed or delayed refund caused by incorrect or incomplete information provided by the participant.
Participants should provide banking information only through a communication method approved by MSV Incognito.
26. Cancellation or changes by MSV Incognito
MSV Incognito may make reasonable changes to the programme, schedule, activities, accommodation, food arrangements or transport where necessary because of:

items: Circumstances outside MSV Incognito’s reasonable control.

blocks.text: MSV Incognito will communicate material changes as soon as reasonably possible.
A minor programme or scheduling change does not automatically entitle a participant to a refund.
Where a material change significantly affects the main characteristics of the event, MSV Incognito will provide any option, refund or other remedy required by applicable law.
If MSV Incognito cancels the entire event, participants will receive a refund of the ticket price or another remedy agreed with the participant, subject to applicable law.

MSV Incognito is not responsible for additional personal expenses such as separately booked travel, clothing or equipment unless responsibility for those expenses follows from mandatory applicable law.
27. Limitation of responsibility
To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, MSV Incognito is not responsible for injury, illness, death, loss, damage, expense or other consequences resulting from:

items: A participant’s own intentional, reckless, negligent, dangerous or unlawful conduct;
Self-inflicted injury resulting from the participant’s own conduct;
A participant causing injury or death to another person;
A participant’s failure to follow this agreement;
A participant’s failure to follow a reasonable safety instruction;
A participant’s consumption of alcohol or other substances;
A participant participating while medically or physically unable to do so safely;
Incorrect or incomplete information provided by a participant;
The unlawful or unauthorised conduct of another participant;
The conduct of an unrelated third party;
Loss or theft of unattended personal belongings;
Missing or invalid identification or travel documentation;
Circumstances outside MSV Incognito’s reasonable control.

blocks.text: Each participant remains responsible for the consequences of their own conduct.
Nothing in this agreement excludes or limits responsibility where doing so is prohibited by applicable Dutch, Belgian or European Union law.

In particular, this agreement does not exclude legally non-excludable responsibility arising from MSV Incognito’s own intentional conduct, serious fault or another act or omission for which responsibility cannot lawfully be excluded.
Nothing in this agreement prevents a participant from exercising mandatory legal rights.
28. Insurance
Participants are strongly advised to possess insurance that is valid in Belgium and appropriate for the event, including where relevant:
Each participant is responsible for checking the terms and territorial coverage of their insurance.
MSV Incognito does not guarantee that a participant’s insurance will cover a particular incident.
Possessing insurance does not remove the participant’s obligation to behave responsibly.
29. Photographs and video recordings
Photographs and video recordings may be created during Intro Camp 2026 for event documentation, internal association purposes and possible promotion of MSV Incognito activities.
Where required, the use of identifiable photographs or videos for public promotional purposes will be based on a separate optional media-consent choice.
Refusing promotional media consent does not prevent a person from purchasing a ticket or attending the event.
Participants should inform a coordinator or photographer where they do not wish to be intentionally photographed or recorded.
MSV Incognito will take reasonable steps to respect such requests but cannot guarantee that a participant will never appear incidentally in a crowd, background or wide-angle event image.
Participants must not publish humiliating, intimate, dangerous or seriously compromising images or recordings of another person.
Participants must respect requests from other people not to be photographed or recorded.
30. Privacy and personal information
MSV Incognito may process personal information necessary to:

items: Address dietary, accessibility and health needs;

blocks.text: Information may be shared with:
where reasonably necessary and legally permitted.
Medical and health information will be treated as sensitive information. Access will be limited to persons who reasonably require it.
Questions or requests concerning personal information may be sent to:
incognito@maastrichtuniversity.nl
31. Applicable law and cross-border incidents
The contractual relationship between the participant and MSV Incognito is governed by Dutch law to the extent that this choice is legally permitted.
This choice does not deprive a participant of mandatory protections provided by applicable Dutch, Belgian or European Union law.
Participants must comply with Belgian law while travelling to, attending and returning from the event.
The law applicable to an injury, property-damage incident, criminal matter or other non-contractual event occurring in Belgium may be determined by mandatory Belgian and European rules.
The court or authority competent to address a dispute or incident will be determined under applicable mandatory national and European rules.
Before beginning formal legal proceedings, participants and MSV Incognito are encouraged to attempt to resolve complaints through reasonable communication, unless urgent action is required.
32. Questions and complaints
Participants are encouraged to contact MSV Incognito without hesitation regarding any question, problem or complaint.
Questions before or after the event may be sent to:
incognito@maastrichtuniversity.nl
Problems or questions during the event should be raised directly with a designated coordinator.
MSV Incognito will assess concerns reasonably based on:

items: The rights of the persons involved;

blocks.text: Nothing in this section prevents a participant from directly contacting emergency services, the police, medical professionals or another competent organisation.
33. Changes to this agreement
MSV Incognito may correct minor errors or make changes required by law, safety requirements or circumstances outside its reasonable control.
Material changes made after a participant has purchased a ticket will be communicated to the participant.
Where legally required, participants may be asked to accept an updated version.
The version accepted during registration should remain available for reference.
34. Severability
If any provision of this agreement is found to be invalid, unfair or unenforceable, that provision will apply only to the maximum extent legally permitted or will be removed.
The remaining provisions will continue to apply where legally possible.
35. Participant acknowledgement
By accepting this agreement, the participant confirms that:

items: They have read and understood this Participant Agreement, Camp Rules, Payment and Refund Policy;
They have had the opportunity to contact MSV Incognito with questions;
They understand that the event takes place in Belgium;
They agree to comply with Belgian law;
They agree to comply with venue rules;
They agree to follow reasonable instructions from MSV Incognito coordinators;
They understand that they remain responsible for their own conduct and decisions;
They understand that they may be personally responsible for injury, death, loss or damage caused by their conduct;
They will carry valid identification, required travel documents and their personal event ticket;
They understand that tickets are normally paid through Pretix;
They understand that bank-transfer payment is possible only after a request has been approved by MSV Incognito;
They understand the refund deadline of 1 September 2026 at 23:59 CEST;
They understand that cancellations after the refund deadline are normally non-refundable;
They understand that they may propose an eligible replacement participant after the refund deadline;
They understand that a replacement is not valid until approved in writing by MSV Incognito;
They understand that some iDEAL refunds may need to be processed manually;
They agree to contact a coordinator promptly regarding problems, concerns or unsafe situations;
They understand that serious misconduct may result in removal from the event without a refund, subject to mandatory law;

They understand that fire alarms, fire extinguishers and other fire-safety equipment may be used only for genuine or reasonably believed emergencies and must never be abused, obstructed, damaged or tampered with;
They confirm that the information supplied during registration is accurate.
